text.title: Cinder Wards
text.body: Three corrupted rune-circles anchor a volatile barrier over a coastal sacrificial altar, threatening to shear Oakhaven's cliffs into the sea. Guided by Chronicler Zahra's Redmarsh wardstone notes, Ward-Scholar Elowen directs you to shatter the West, North, and East rune circles before breaking the Central Altar Warden.
text.obj.0: Shatter the three outer rune guardian circles
text.obj.1: Defeat the Central Altar Warden and guard
text.msg.1: Chronicler Zahra's Redmarsh notes confirm the resonance pattern: cinder golems and fire-imps anchor three outer wards. Break the outer circles first or Oakhaven's cliffs will shear into the ocean!
text.msg.2: The Western Ward collapses into dead cinder, exposing an ancient offertory coffer of four hundred star-silver florins!
text.msg.3: The Northern Ward fractures into black obsidian, yielding four hundred ancient crowns nestled within the ward-socket!
text.msg.4: The Eastern Ward douses its flame, releasing four hundred uncorrupted sovereigns from the altar vault!
text.msg.5: All three outer wards are shattered! The Central Altar Warden advances—watch its sweeping magma arcs!
text.msg.6: The corrupted altar shatters; the cliffside wards hum back to steady blue resonance.
text.win: Every cinder ward is extinguished and Oakhaven's coastal wards hold steady.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell beneath the cinder wards.
